g.text: Scenario: schedule a flight (Saga across three services, with compensations)
status, min capacity and range, distance
[404/409 (route gone or inactive) or airports-routes down]
compensation: C4 PUT copy CANCELED (frees the aircraft)
If it cannot be delivered, it is stored
Each copy carries the flight's version: C4 and C5 are idempotent
(a repeated or older copy changes nothing), so a step can be retried.
